sections.heading: The Geometric Box That Stands Out & Stacks Up
sections.text: Six-Sided Rigid Geometry The Geometric Box That Stands Out & Stacks Up A hexagon gift box breaks the monotony of square cartons with a confident six-sided silhouette. That distinct geometry is exactly why premium candle, jewelry, beauty and subscription brands choose hexagon rigid boxes to look intentional on shelf and in unboxing videos. Ours are built from heavyweight greyboard (1.5–2mm) wrapped in your printed art paper, soft-touch or textured stock, so each of the six faces stays crisp and the corners sit sharp. Choose a lift-off telescoping lid or a hidden magnetic closure, with a custom-cut velvet, EVA or satin insert that cradles your product. The flat top and bottom make hexagon boxes neatly stackable — a practical bonus for retail display and gift-set bundling. Finish with gold foil, blind emboss or a ribbon pull to complete a premium first touch.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Questions Frequently Asked Questions What is a hexagon gift box? A hexagon gift box is a six-sided rigid box built from heavyweight greyboard wrapped in printed paper, with either a lift-off telescoping lid or a hidden magnetic closure. Its distinctive geometry stands out from square cartons and stacks neatly for display. Are hexagon boxes stackable? Yes. The flat top and base allow hexagon boxes to stack cleanly, which is ideal for retail merchandising and bundling multi-box gift sets. What is the minimum order quantity for custom hexagon boxes? Standard MOQ is 100 pcs for a custom size with full printing and a velvet insert — accessible for boutique launches and PR campaigns. Can I choose a magnetic lid or a lift-off lid? Both. We offer a hidden magnetic snap closure or a classic telescoping lift-off lid (lid & base), depending on the unboxing experience you want. What inserts are available for hexagon boxes? Custom velvet-flocked trays, EVA foam, satin linings, paper pulp and card dividers — cut to your product for rings, jars, bottles or multi-item sets.
